posts.author: Jojuga
posts.body: Hello everyone! I was looking to make a game in MZ, but I love the look and feel of XP. Since in MZ you can downsize the tileset to match XPs 32x32, I was wondering if it was as easy as dragging all the files over? If anyone has any experience in this or knowledge I would great appreciate it, thank you!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
unfortunately that doesn't work.
VX, VXA, MV and MZ have the same or similar tilesheet structures - in those cases it will work.
XP had a different tilesheet structure, especially considering the XP autotiles.
Those cannot be copied over, they would have to be reworked.
